name: Change Area
description: data-flow and behavior-delta: which part of the plugin the change is in, and what that part owes.

globalState.callers: references to the changed functions outside their own files

config.instructions: state.diff is a git diff of a C++ JUCE MIDI plugin that walks a user-drawn graph. Which area does the change belong to? Judge by the file paths and what the changed code does.

options.label: Traversal: how the graph is walked, or the per-traversal state the walk keeps (Source/Audio traversal classes, NodeStateTable, Source/Script)
Audio thread outside the walk: MIDI scheduling, transport, snapshot publication
Graph model: the ValueTree document, node and arrow properties, pitch and duration bindings (Source/Graph)
UI components, editors and painting only (Source/UI)

config.statement: The diff in state.diff changes which node a traversal visits next, or how per-node visit counts and limits are stored or advanced.

config.description: The walk changed; walk parity is owed.
config.directive: This changes the walk. Run the same graph shape as a node traversal and as a modulator walk and compare the sequences (TraversalTests.cpp, mirrorAsModulators); add the shape there if it is new.

effects.block:
change_area -> walk-changed: This changes the walk. Run the same graph shape as a node traversal and as a modulator walk and compare the sequences (TraversalTests.cpp, mirrorAsModulators); add the shape there if it is new.
Do what this asks, or say in one line where this turn already did it.

config.description: Traversal code changed without changing the walk.
Audio-thread code outside the walk changed.
config.directive: This touches the audio thread. Confirm nothing reached from processBlock allocates, locks or blocks; the RealtimeSanitizer build in CLAUDE.md's Tests section is the check.

effects.block:
change_area -> audio-thread: This touches the audio thread. Confirm nothing reached from processBlock allocates, locks or blocks; the RealtimeSanitizer build in CLAUDE.md's Tests section is the check.
Do what this asks, or say in one line where this turn already did it.

config.directive: This changes the graph model. Confirm arrow geometry still sets duration and a pitch-bound arrow only shifts pitch; SequenceTree_GraphTests covers both.

effects.block:
change_area -> graph-model: This changes the graph model. Confirm arrow geometry still sets duration and a pitch-bound arrow only shifts pitch; SequenceTree_GraphTests covers both.
